info.title: TranscriptLayer API
info.description: Multi-platform exact-caption contract. YouTube is the first supported source Adapter. The earlier YouTube request shape is deployed to isolated Cloudflare staging; this source-neutral pre-beta contract is not yet deployed.

x-billing-contract: One completed selected track costs one credit, whether served from cache or extracted. Failed and successfully cancelled requests cost zero.
x-freshness-contract: Omitted max_age_seconds accepts any valid stored successful artifact. This is archival reuse, not a current-source guarantee.
x-source-access-contract: Before first cross-account reuse and whenever the last successful anonymous access check is older than 604800 seconds, validate source accessibility without refreshing captions. Deny private, deleted, restricted, or unverifiable sources.

x-retention-contract.shared_successful_artifacts: indefinite subject to denial, removal, corruption, and renderer compatibility

x-batch-admission-contract: Atomic reservation for every item; duplicate references and duplicate normalized source-plus-selection requests are rejected.
x-customer-deletion-contract: DELETE immediately hides the customer resource, fences unsettled work, and returns 202 until erasure finishes, then 204. Content-free deletion and idempotency tombstones remain for seven days after erasure.
x-thumbnail-contract: Thumbnail bytes are fetched only after an authenticated thumbnail GET, cost no transcript credit, and never change transcript completion or observed_at.
x-batch-retry-contract: Failed items are retried only by creating a new atomic batch with an explicit new idempotency key; no terminal batch or item is mutated in place.

x-owner-gateway-contract.mutation_origin_policy: POST and DELETE require the exact configured dashboard Origin. GET rejects a present non-dashboard Origin.
x-owner-gateway-contract.credential_policy: The browser sends the opaque HttpOnly owner cookie with credentials included. The gateway never exposes a TranscriptLayer API key or WorkOS token.

get.description: Returns a minute-level materialized view of the API, transcript processing, webhook delivery, and up to ten current or recent public incidents. It does not expose proxy counts, queue depth, customer activity, credentials, or provider details. A snapshot older than three minutes reports unknown instead of claiming health. An active incident can only raise, never lower, its affected component state.

Returns the current or one of the previous 12 UTC calendar months' 99.5% API and cached-delivery service-level calculation. Missing synthetic buckets make availability unknown. Planned maintenance requires at least 24 hours of notice and can exclude at most four hours in one calendar month. Uncached extraction completion is reported as a separate operational objective and cannot earn service credits while the service depends on one proxy provider.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Current or one of the previous 12 UTC calendar months. Defaults to the current month.

200.description: Service-level period and its durable evidence counts

get.summary: Read the current browser owner session
get.description: Runs only on the owner gateway. Returns the account role and display identity without exposing API keys, provider tokens, provider session IDs, or cookie values.

get.summary: Read account status and credit balances
get.description: Requires account:read. This route reports credit state but cannot change a plan, payment method, or account status.

post.summary: Close the current account and begin durable erasure
post.description: Owner-session only. Requires the exact dashboard Origin, an account-ID confirmation, and a verified WorkOS auth_time no more than five minutes old. Acceptance closes the account and revokes its API keys and browser identities before returning. The owner gateway clears the local session cookie. The freshness fence is locally tested; the WorkOS-backed flow remains a live production gate.

202.description: Closure accepted; customer access is revoked and durable erasure is pending, processing, or complete

get.summary: List subscription plans, eligible top-ups, and checkout availability
get.description: Owner-session only. Returns the two active subscription plans, current subscription state, and only the top-up eligible for that active plan. Provider price IDs and reconciliation details are never exposed.

post.summary: Create or replay one hosted credit-pack checkout
post.description: Owner-session only. The idempotency key binds one account and price version. Checkout has a separate hourly account limit: admitted idempotent replays do not consume another slot, and funded accounts may have a higher configured limit. HTTP 429 uses checkout_rate_limited and includes Retry-After. A browser redirect is never proof of payment; poll the returned receipt after Stripe redirects back.

post.summary: Stop the current subscription from renewing
post.description: Owner-session only. Schedules the current paid subscription to end after its present term. Existing credits and any scheduled grants within the paid annual term remain available. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: Owner-session only. Returns subscription invoices, top-ups, and checkout states without provider customer, payment, charge, refund, dispute, or invoice IDs.

Owner-session only. Accepts a checkout session ID after a hosted-checkout return or a public receipt ID from billing history. Server-retained state, not the return query string, determines payment state.
Requires api_keys:read. Returns at most the account limit of 20 active, unexpired keys. Raw secrets and secret hashes are never returned.

post.description: Requires api_keys:write and Idempotency-Key. Requested scopes must be a subset of the current key's scopes. The raw secret appears only in the first 201 response and is stored only as a SHA-256 verifier. Creation attempts retain only the normalized request hash and created key ID for seven days. Replaying the same request returns idempotency_secret_unavailable with the exact resource_id so the caller can revoke the orphan and retry with a new key. A different request with the same idempotency key returns idempotency_conflict. New API-key and webhook-endpoint creations share an hourly account limit. An admitted retry with the same operation and idempotency key does not consume another slot. HTTP 429 uses control_plane_rate_limited and includes Retry-After.

201.description: API key created; copy secret now

post.description: Owner-session-only emergency control. Requires the exact dashboard Origin and account-ID confirmation. The browser owner identity remains active so the owner can create a one-time recovery key. Revocation affects later authentication and does not cancel requests that already passed authentication and entered a durable authority.

200.description: Every API key that was active when the update ran is revoked

delete.description: Requires api_keys:write. Unknown, cross-account, already revoked, and repeated requests return 204. The last active api_keys:write key cannot be revoked until a replacement exists.

202.description: Endpoint is disabled, but indexed delivery fencing is still running; repeat this DELETE after Retry-After

204.description: Endpoint is absent or deletion is complete

post.summary: Get or start one selected transcript track

200.description: Durably admitted request reached completed or failed within the wait budget

202.description: Durable request accepted and still queued or processing

get.summary: Poll or retrieve one transcript request

delete.summary: Hide and erase one customer transcript resource

202.description: Access is revoked and cancel-and-erase work is still running; repeat this DELETE after Retry-After

204.description: Customer erasure completed; a content-free tombstone still prevents accidental idempotency replay

post.summary: Cancel before the selected-track commit grant

200.description: Cancelled resource or an already cancelled resource

get.summary: Lazily materialize and download an optional thumbnail without exposing an upstream URL

200.description: Validated stored thumbnail; thumbnail availability never blocks transcript completion and costs no transcript credit

202.description: One coalesced thumbnail materialization is still running

304.description: The stored thumbnail still matches If-None-Match

200.description: Batches ordered from newest to oldest

post.summary: Submit up to 1,000 explicit transcript items

200.description: Batch resource without embedded item results

delete.summary: Hide and erase a batch and its customer item resources

202.description: Access is revoked and item cancellation or erasure is still running; repeat this DELETE after Retry-After

204.description: Batch and customer item erasure completed; content-free tombstones still prevent accidental idempotency replay

post.summary: Cancel every item that has not crossed its commit grant

200.description: Current batch resource after cancellation fencing; status remains cancelling until every item is terminal

post.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. Creates a pending endpoint and returns its signing secret. Verify ownership before using the endpoint on transcript or batch requests. An account may have at most 100 active endpoints. New API-key and webhook-endpoint creations share an hourly account limit. An admitted retry with the same operation and idempotency key does not consume another slot. HTTP 429 uses control_plane_rate_limited and includes Retry-After.

201.description: Pending endpoint; store signing_secret because later reads omit it

delete.summary: Delete a webhook destination and exhaust its pending deliveries

204.description: Endpoint is absent and no later retry will use it; repeated deletion and unknown account-local IDs also return 204

post.summary: Verify control of a webhook destination
post.description: Sends a signed endpoint.verification event. The receiver must return the supplied challenge in a 2xx JSON response. Verification is limited to five attempts per account per hour.
Requires Idempotency-Key. Returns the new secret. Deliveries carry current and previous signature pairs for 24 hours. A second rotation is blocked until that overlap ends.

200.description: Rotated endpoint; store signing_secret because later reads omit it

get.description: Returns newest first. Receiver response bodies are never retained. Terminal history expires after 30 days.

get.summary: Get one webhook delivery and its attempts

post.summary: Create a new delivery for a terminal event
post.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. The new delivery keeps the original immutable event ID so receiver deduplication remains valid. Only delivered or exhausted events with a live resource and enabled endpoint can be replayed.

get.summary: Read account request analytics and recent diagnostics
get.description: Requires analytics:read. Metrics are grouped by the UTC hour in which each request was admitted, so outcome rates use a coherent request cohort. The current UTC hour and previous window_hours minus one hourly buckets are included. Execution averages expose queue, processing, source-wait, and final source-work phases with explicit sample coverage. Raw transcript text, source IDs, account IDs, and provider or proxy internals are excluded.

Requires analytics:read. The lookup is bound to the authenticated account. Unknown request IDs and IDs owned by another account both return 404. Raw transcript text, source IDs, account IDs, and provider or proxy internals are excluded.

post.summary: Receive a thin terminal resource event

parameters.name: TranscriptLayer-Signature
parameters.description: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256> using the current signing key.

parameters.name: TranscriptLayer-Previous-Key-Id
parameters.description: Present during the 24-hour overlap after secret rotation.

parameters.name: TranscriptLayer-Previous-Signature
parameters.description: Signature paired with TranscriptLayer-Previous-Key-Id during rotation overlap.

200.description: Any 2xx response acknowledges this delivery attempt

bearerKey.description: Named, scoped TranscriptLayer API key. Never pass it in a URL.

ownerSession.name: __Host-tl_owner
ownerSession.description: Opaque encrypted browser session issued by the owner gateway. JavaScript cannot read it. Browser calls use credentials: include.

webhookSignature.name: TranscriptLayer-Signature
webhookSignature.description: HMAC signature over the exact body, timestamp, event ID, schema version, and key ID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retained through nonterminal work and for seven days after terminal state. Reuse after expiry may create and charge a new request.

WebhookActionIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
WebhookActionIdempotencyKey.description: Makes a webhook action safe to retry. Endpoint-creation keys replay while the original signing key remains current, conflict after secret rotation, and remain as tombstones for seven days after deletion. Replay keys remain bound until the 30-day delivery history expires. Rotation keys replay only while their returned key is still current.

Prefer.name: Prefer
Prefer.description: Supports respond-async or wait=N, where N is from 0 through 10 seconds.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Return 304 when the current representation matches this entity tag.

ThumbnailCache.description: Whether this request materialized the thumbnail, served stored bytes, or joined work already in progress.

RateLimitLimit.description: Published request limit for the current account window. The limit can increase after the account receives its first verified purchase grant.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current account window.

RateLimitReset.description: UTC epoch seconds when the current account window resets.

spendable.description: Credits available for new admission after reservations.

status.description: Whether the account may admit new transcript and batch work.

debt_credits.description: Consumed credits later reversed by a refund or chargeback and not yet reconciled.

confirmation.description: Must exactly equal the account ID in the authenticated owner session.

expires_at.description: Optional UTC expiry. Omit or set null for no expiry.

last_used_at.description: Updated at most once every 15 minutes.
Updated at most once every 15 minutes.

secret.description: Returned only by a successful create response.

url.description: URL from a supported source platform. It is parsed to a canonical identity and never fetched as a generic URL.

platform.description: Registered source platform. YouTube is the first supported value.

id.description: Canonical route-safe source ID. The selected source Adapter validates or derives it from the provider identity.

max_age_seconds.description: Omit to accept any valid stored successful artifact. Zero forces a fresh observation.

reference.description: Allowed only on a batch item.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: Allowed only on a single request; a batch sets one endpoint at the batch level.

access_validated_at.description: Most recent successful anonymous source-access check. This is separate from caption observed_at.

source_market.description: Two-letter source access market used for this observation.

access_expires_at.description: Caption-content access ends at this instant. Present only for completed transcripts.

BatchCounts.x-invariant: queued + processing + completed + failed + cancelled equals total

processing_samples.description: Terminal requests with coherent admission, processing, and completion timestamps. Queue and processing averages use this denominator.

source_samples.description: Terminal requests with a coherent last source-attempt timestamp. Source wait and source execution averages use this denominator.

diagnostic_samples.description: Terminal requests with recorded source-attempt and capacity-wait counters. Older requests can lack these diagnostics.

average_source_wait_ms.description: Mean time from processing start to the last source attempt. This includes durable scheduling, capacity waits, and earlier retries.

average_source_execution_ms.description: Mean time from the last source attempt through source work, publication, and request settlement.

source_attempts.description: Extractor or access-check attempts that reached source work and consumed the retry budget. Cache-only reads are zero. A null value means no exact source-settlement diagnostic is available.

capacity_waits.description: Extractor dispatches refused before source access because the proxy fleet had no capacity. These waits do not consume the source retry budget. A null value means no exact source-settlement diagnostic is available.

source_last_attempt_at.description: Time of the last extractor or access-check dispatch, including a dispatch refused for capacity. A null value means no source dispatch occurred or no exact source-settlement diagnostic is available.

url.description: HTTPS port 443 URL with a public DNS hostname, no userinfo, and no fragment.

signing_secret.description: Returned only by endpoint creation or an idempotent secret-rotation response.

request_id.description: Correlation ID for a transcript admission. Batch events omit this field because their items have separate request IDs.

resource_id.description: Exact resource created by an ambiguous idempotent operation. Present only when the caller must identify and revoke a resource whose one-time secret cannot be replayed.

access_expires_at.description: The ended caption-content access window. Present for caption_access_expired.
